articles.title: Match of the Day
articles.description: Featuring five games, including matches involving pacesetters Arsenal and Man City.

articles.title: York score after 10 seconds against Northampton following unique kick-off
articles.description: Ollie Pearce scores after 10 seconds as York City see off Northampton Town in a 4-0  win to reach the second round of the FA Cup.

articles.title: Pearce double fires York City past Northampton Town
articles.description: Ollie Pearce scores after just 10 seconds as York stroll to an FA Cup first-round win at home to Northampton.

articles.title: Non-league Barrow beat League Two Gillingham with injury-time winner
articles.description: Innes Cameron's 92nd minute goal sends National League side Barrow into the second round of the FA Cup, as they snatch a 1-0 victory at Gillingham.

articles.title: Highlights: Exeter shock League One leaders Huddersfield
articles.description: League Two Exeter City pull off an upset 2-1 win away to League One leaders Huddersfield Town to progress into the second round of the FA Cup.

articles.title: McNeill's superb halfway goal sparks Crewe upset over Wimbledon
articles.description: Charlie McNeill's strike from the halfway line helps League Two frontrunners Crewe progress to the second round of the FA Cup, with a 2-1 win over League One AFC Wimbledon.

articles.title: 'Bruno's as good as ever' - Carrick backs Man Utd captain
articles.description: Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick says captain Bruno Fernandes' commitment to the club is "undoubted" and the midfielder is "as good as ever".

articles.title: Randall's last-gasp winner sends Chesterfield past Yeovil in seven-goal thriller
articles.description: Chesterfield fend off a Yeovil Town second-half fightback before scoring a late winner to secure a 4-3 victory in the first round of the FA Cup.

articles.title: Rotherham end 10-game losing run with FA Cup win over Bromley
articles.description: Goals from Sonny Aljofree and Tom Bradshaw earn Rotherham a 2-0 victory over Bromley in the FA Cup first round.

articles.title: Liverpool considering Verbruggen move - Sunday's gossip
articles.description: Liverpool consider move for Brighton keeper Bart Verbruggen, Bayern Munich remain in talks with Rio Ngumoha's camp, Tottenham midfielder Conor Gallagher monitored by rival Premier League clubs, plus more.

articles.title: Port Vale defeat non-league Scunthorpe in FA Cup
articles.description: Last season's quarter-finalists Port Vale book their place in the FA Cup second round with victory over National League side Scunthorpe United at Vale Park.

articles.title: Glasner glee and Delap double - win could be lift-off for Forest
articles.description: Oliver Glasner's celebrations and two goals for Liam Delap bode well for a Nottingham Forest team looking to kick on after their first home Premier League win of the season.

articles.title: Notts County beat Altrincham in incredible fog-filled spectacle
articles.description: Notts County find a way to get past National League Altrincham in incredible conditions.

articles.title: Maresca's dream start turns into nightmare as title hopes hit
articles.description: Enzo Maresca left the City Ground on Saturday evening with chants of "can we play you every week?" ringing in his ears - the Italian's dream start as Manchester City manager is rapidly turning into a nightmare.

articles.title: Delap double inspires Forest to stunning win over Man City
articles.description: Liam Delap scores a superb double as Nottingham Forest stun Manchester City 3-1 for their first Premier League win at the City Ground this season.

articles.title: Muniz strike denies Newcastle and Jaissle much-needed win
articles.description: Rodrigo Muniz scores his first goal since the opening day of last season as Fulham deny Newcastle and head coach Matthias Jaissle a much-needed win at Craven Cottage.

articles.title: Leeds beat Spurs to end five-game winless run
articles.description: Noah Okafor scores the only goal of the game to give Leeds United their first win since the 14th of September, as Tottenham are beaten 1-0 at Elland Road in the Premier League.

articles.title: Arsenal beat Hull to extend lead at top of the table
articles.description: Arsenal captain Martin Odegaard scores the winner as his side beat Hull City to extend their lead at the top of the Premier League table.

articles.title: Newport cup tie halted by alleged homophobic chants
articles.description: Newport manager Hayden Mullins condemns alleged abusive chants during Saturday's FA Cup tie against Walsall.

articles.title: Another 1-0 for relentless Arsenal - but did Odegaard spare VAR blushes?
articles.description: Arsenal move six points clear at the top of the Premier League after beating Hull City - but did Martin Odegaard's goal save the blushes of the VAR?

articles.title: Delightful Delap and outfought Anderson - Forest v Man City player ratings
articles.description: How Nottingham Forest and Manchester City's players rated following their Premier League match at the City Ground.

articles.title: Argentina set to go to Cas after Fifa rejects appeals
articles.description: The Argentina Football Association says it is planning to go to the Court of Arbitration for Sport over Fifa rejecting its appeals against World Cup punishments.

articles.title: Title race hots up before Chelsea-Man City showdown
articles.description: Champions Manchester City will travel to Chelsea next week on top of the pile after a decisive Saturday in the Women's Super League.

articles.title: FA Cup: Charlie Savage nets against dad Robbie as Reading thrash Peterborough
Rangers end winless away run with comfortable victory at St Mirren
articles.description: Rangers moved one point behind Scottish Premiership leaders Celtic thanks to goals from Ryan Naderi and Dan Neil in a 2-0 win over St Mirren.

articles.title: 'A different Noni?' Madueke finding a new level for Arsenal
articles.description: Noni Madueke lay sprawled on the turf, head in his hands, following his one-on-one miss late in Arsenal's 1-0 victory over Hull. His frustration continued to show even after the final whistle.

articles.description: Rodrigo Muniz's unorthodox equaliser denied Matthias Jaissle a pressure-relieving victory but his Newcastle side were still much improved in a deserved 1-1 draw at Fulham.
